rows.en: －　Corridor　－
＊Eiji＊＠０３２＿０２What's with the gloomy face?!￥Training's over, right?
＊Eiji＊＠０３２＿０３Looks like the latest data on￥Elan just came in.
＊Eiji＊＠０３２＿０４I'm gonna go check it out.￥Come with me!
－　Monitor Room　－＝－　Images of Elan are on screen　－
＊Eiji＊＠０３２＿０５Whoooaaa...￥It's really beautiful, huh.￥Amazing...
＊Eiji＊＠０３２＿０６Man...￥Pretty soon we'll be landing￥on this planet, huh.
＊Eiji＊＠０３２＿０７I'm already getting pumped.￥Can't wait to get there!
Yeah, I can't wait.
I guess...
Yes, I can't wait.
I suppose...
＊Eiji＊＠０３２＿０８Right?!￥I knew you'd feel the same!＝＠０３２＿０９Argh, I wanna go￥right now!
＊Eiji＊＠０３２＿１０Why do we have to wait so many￥days for the final exam?
＊Eiji＊＠０３２＿１１Seriously, you...＝＠０３２＿１２You're looking at a planet this￥gorgeous, and that's all you￥say? Where's your drive?!
＊Eiji＊＠０３２＿１３Me, I've been dying to go￥to Elan for ages.
＊Eiji＊＠０３２＿１４When I heard I'd been picked￥as a candidate...＝＠０３２＿１５I couldn't sit still. I started￥packing for Alpha right then￥and there.
＊Eiji＊＠０３２＿１６My dad laughed and said I was￥jumping the gun, but man,￥I was so happy.
＊Eiji＊I mean,￥＠０３２＿１７only nine people got picked￥as candidates, you know?＝＠０３２＿１８That's already huge, but if￥we actually get to go to Elan...
＊Eiji＊＠０３２＿１９we'll be carrying the hopes of￥all humanity. How cool is that?!
＊Eiji＊＠０３２＿２０I'm going to Elan,￥no matter what!
＊Eiji＊＠０３２＿２１What about you?＝＠０３２＿２２You must've given it plenty of￥thought before coming here too,￥right?
Of course I have.
Not really...
Of course I have.
Not really...
＊Eiji＊＠０３２＿２３Figured. I mean, this is one￥huge project.
＊Eiji＊＠０３２＿２４If it works, we'll be heroes￥overnight, you know?＝＠０３２＿２５Let's give it our all!
＊Eiji＊＠０３２＿２６Huh?! Seriously?
＊Eiji＊＠０３２＿２７Man, you're no fun.
＊Eiji＊＠０３２＿２８You got picked, didn't you? If￥you don't aim higher than that,￥it's a total waste!
＊Eiji＊＠０３２＿２９Let's give it our all!
－　Leaving the Monitor Room,￥　　； and Eiji go back　－

＊Eiji＊＠０３３＿０１Hey, come to think of it, you're￥the same age as me, right?＝＠０３３＿０２When we were kids, didn't￥everyone around you get all￥fired up talking about Elan?＝＠０３３＿０３Like, "Someday we're going to￥that planet of hope!"
＊Eiji＊＠０３３＿０４I grew up hearing that￥all the time, so...＝＠０３３＿０５before I knew it, I really￥believed I'd go to Elan.
＊Eiji＊＠０３３＿０６"I'm gonna change humanity's￥future!" ...Like that.
＊Eiji＊＠０３３＿０７Huh?!￥Did you just laugh at me?!
No, I didn't laugh.
Sorry, it was funny.
No, I didn't laugh.
Sorry, it was funny.
＊Eiji＊＠０３３＿０８Liar!!￥I saw it with my own eyes!
＊Eiji＊＠０３３＿０９That's harsh. It might not be￥just a pipe dream, you know.＝＠０３３＿１０We really do have a chance to￥change the future.
＊Eiji＊＠０３３＿１１That's harsh! It might not be￥just a pipe dream, right?
＊Eiji＊＠０３３＿１２If I get to go, the future￥just might change!
＊Eiji＊＠０３３＿１３Geez...＝＠０３３＿１４Here I am, telling you my￥touching life story, and you go￥and do that. How rude.
＊Eiji＊＠０３３＿１５Keep laughing at people like￥that, and someday you'll get￥burned.＝＠０３３＿１６Like they say, "Learn from￥others' mistakes," right?
Y-yeah, you're right.
That's the wrong saying.
Y-yes, you're right.
Wrong saying, isn't it?
＊Eiji＊＠０３３＿１７Right, right. Or, "He who digs￥a pit for others..."￥Huh?
＊Eiji＊＠０３３＿１８Now I'm all mixed up...￥Eh, whatever.
＊Eiji＊＠０３３＿１９Huh...? Is it?
＊Eiji＊＠０３３＿２０Aw, who cares about￥that stuff?＝＠０３３＿２１Quit nitpicking every little￥thing people say.
＊Eiji＊＠０３４＿０１Hanging out with you reminds me￥of my friends back on Sophia.＝＠０３４＿０２You're easy to talk to.
＊Eiji＊＠０３４＿０５Oh, I know!￥I've got something good for you.￥Wait right here!
＊Eiji＊＠０３４＿０６Hey!￥Sorry to keep you waiting!

＊Eiji＊＠０３４＿０７To celebrate us becoming￥friends, try this. My own￥special drink!＝＠０３４＿０８I used to make it all the time￥on Sophia. My crew loved it.＝＠０３４＿０９We've gotta hit the training￥hard from here on out, right?＝＠０３４＿１０So I figured I'd share some￥of my energy with you.
＊Eiji＊＠０３４＿１１I'm drinking this and giving it￥everything I've got, so don't￥you dare hold back either!
＊Eiji＊＠０３４＿１２Let's both go all out!!
